scope: Public-play golf courses in all 50 US states and DC; incomplete, ongoing acquisition.
record_unit: One provisional golf facility entry with nested course details. Verified groups are explicitly marked; unreviewed source entries may still belong to the same facility. Facility holes are a supported total, never an assumed division into eighteen-hole layouts.
public_access_basis: Explicit public classification, primary-source public/nonmember play offer, or an applicable tourism-directory inclusion criterion explicitly requiring public golf. Conflicting or unverified access remains excluded.
address_basis: Published course or mailing address; city-only listings remain null. Not a verified driving entrance.
freshness: Sources reviewed during compilation beginning October 6, 2026. Source publication dates are often unknown; indexed and older evidence is noted where material. updated_on is the compilation date, not a fresh verification of every row. No claim of real-time operating status.
county_basis: County supported by a Census batch Exact flag plus matching normalized street/city/state (ZIP-only correction allowed), a single-address Census result with matching normalized full street/city/state/five-digit-ZIP, or an explicit primary-source county statement. This identifies the address geography, not the entire course footprint. Missing or ambiguous matches remain null.
rights: Bare facts and explicitly licensed source attributes with citations. No source prose, photographs, map geometry or scorecard artwork included. Applicable source-data licenses and adaptations are recorded below.

state_intake_notes.IA: Association Public-labelled facilities, independently supported public play and Travel Iowa course profiles under its published public-play eligibility criteria; undated profiles retain freshness caveats. Not statewide completeness.
state_intake_notes.NE: 127 Nebraska facilities in association Public filter; unverified Semi-private excluded.
state_intake_notes.ND: 84 entries from the retained pre-cancellation Public-labelled association directory; nine other table entries withheld for identity, alias or eligibility review. The original profile collector remains cancelled; no tail profiles were requested. This is not statewide completeness.
state_intake_notes.CA: NCGA 2026 directory (information current as of December 1, 2025), with flagged stale entries excluded and documented owner corrections; SCGA-only access requires separate operator/government confirmation.
state_intake_notes.GA: Association Public labels plus owner-confirmed public play; missing hole counts stay null.
state_intake_notes.TN: Association Public labels; owner hole-count checks underway.

coverage.county_gap_search: State inventory intake does not establish county completeness. County searches are incomplete, and no result does not establish no public courses.
coverage.count_basis: Facility entries are provisional until grouping is verified. Nested course entries are known single-course records or explicitly verified layouts; unresolved facility totals are not divided. Neither count is a certified percentage of national coverage.

approved_batches.match_basis: one normalized full street/city/state/five-digit-ZIP match; no batch Exact flag asserted

source_licenses.attribution: Utah Geospatial Resource Center (UGRC), formerly AGRC; item owner UtahAGRC
source_licenses.applies_to: Records citing gis.utah.gov or the UtahAGRC GolfCourses feature service
source_licenses.changes: Selected Public/Municipal records; omitted geometry and unrelated attributes; normalized names; added independently sourced addresses; corrected documented legacy names and holes; withheld ambiguous records.

coordinate_basis: Coordinates are retained Census address-range estimates for strictly accepted public street-address matches, not verified course entrances, centroids, survey locations or routing destinations. Null means no qualifying retained coordinate evidence.
